Onion Cheese Muffins
By: Anonymous
Published: Wednesday, December 16, 2009 - 12:07am

Ingredients




1 1/2 cups biscuit mix (reduced Fat)
3/4 cup shredded American cheese (lowfat)
colby or cheddar divided use
1 lrg egg
1/2 cup skim milk
1 small onion finely chopped
1 tablespoon butter or margarine
1 tablespoon toasted sesame seeds

Preparation

1 Combine the baking mix and 1/2 cup of cheese in a large bowl; set aside. 2 In a small bowl, beat egg and milk; set aside. In a small skillet, saute onion in butter until tender; add to egg mixture. Stir into cheese mixture just until moistened. Fill greased or paper-lined muffin cups three-fourths full. Top with the sesame seeds and remaining cheese. Bake at 400F for 18-20 minutes or until muffins test done. Cool in pan 10 minutes. Serve warm. 3 Description:"Zesty and Zippy no fuss muffins" 4 Yield: 6 muffins
